조지 워싱턴 동상 설치 요구

(Request to Install a Statue of George Washington)

재생속도
재생할 문장을 선택하세요00:00.0 / 00:41.7

※ 영어 단어를 클릭하면 그 지점부터 음성이 재생됩니다.

In a Truth Social post Friday night, President Donald Trump called on the Smithsonian to replace the “Infinity” sculpture in front of the National Museum of American History with a 30-foot statue of George Washington. Trump is also asking for a George Washington exhibit to run through February 22, 2032, the 300th anniversary of Washington's birth. And for Constitution Day on September 17, Trump wants the Smithsonian to install in the museum's Flag Hall the same 11-foot George Washington statue that was recently featured at the Freedom 250 IndyCar race. It's not clear whether Trump has the power to order the museum to make the changes. Donna Warder, Washington.
00:00.0 / 00:13.0

듣기 힌트 replace the in-FIN-i-ty sculpture
